cns_fixer_fix_desc: Scans active mods for duplicate IDs, Package_Id conflicts between mods, global replacements of original game assets, and IoStore integrity errors. It also finds CNS menu entries whose required package is not installed. Compatible outfits are converted to CNS; remaining conflicts, damaged containers, and descriptors whose entries have no installed outfit assets are moved to recoverable backups under ~mods/disabled after confirmation.
cns_fixer_fix_note: This changes the active installation after confirmation. Compatible outfits are installed as isolated CNS packages. Entries whose required outfit assets are missing are removed from mixed descriptors; each original JSON is backed up with a .disabled suffix under ~mods/disabled. Re-enable and redeploy the source mod in Vortex to restore its assets.
cns_fixer_fix_confirm: The tool will scan active ~mods, isolate compatible outfits whose packages collide with other mods, repair IoStore errors it can fix, and remove CNS entries whose required assets are missing. Original descriptors and remaining conflicts or damaged containers are backed up with a .disabled suffix under ~mods/disabled. Continue?
